 (i == selectedIndex)
                    c.Card.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Secondary
                    c.Card.BackgroundTransparency = isSel and 0 or 0.4
                    c.Stroke.Color = isSel and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
                    c.Stroke.Transparency = isSel and 0 or 0.4
                    if c.Label then
                        c.Label.TextColor3 = isSel and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text
                        c.Label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", isSel and "AccentText" or "Text")
                    end
                end
            end

            for i, item in ipairs(items) do
                local Card = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = GridHolder,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 9,
                })
                corner(Card, 10)
                local CardStroke = stroke(Card, Theme.Stroke, 1.5, 0.4)

                mk("ImageLabel", {
                    Parent = Card,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 130),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = item.Image or "",
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                })

                local Label = nil
                local labelText = item.LabelES and GetText(item.LabelES, item.LabelEN)
                if labelText then
                    Label = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Card,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 32),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -36),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = labelText,
                        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                        TextSize = 12,
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                        TextWrapped = true,
                        ZIndex = 10,
                    })
                    Label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                    Label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", item.LabelES)
                    Label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", item.LabelEN)
                end

                local Btn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Card,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    ZIndex = 11,
                })

                cards[i] = { Card = Card, Stroke = CardStroke, Label = Label }

                Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    local isSelected
                    if selectable then
                        if selectedIndex == i then
                            selectedIndex = nil
                            isSelected = false
                        else
                            selectedIndex = i
                            isSelected = true
                        end
                        refreshSelection()
                    else
                        isSelected = true
                    end
                    pcall(callback, item, i, isSelected)
                end)
            end

            refreshSelection()
            if contentParent == TabPage then resetScrollTop(TabPage) end

            return {
                Holder = GridHolder,
                GetSelected = function()
                    return selectedIndex
                end,
                SetSelected = function(index)
                    selectedIndex = index
                    refreshSelection()
                end,
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateWelcomeCard()
            if self._homeBuilt then
                return self._homeRoot
            end

            self._homeBuilt = true

            local HomeRoot = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 296),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = false,
                ZIndex = 9,
            })
            self._homeRoot = HomeRoot

            local function makeStatCard(parent, xScale, y, wScale, h, iconId, titleES, titleEN, valueText, subES, subEN)

                    Parent = Card,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24),

                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,

                Value:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

                local Dot = mk("Frame", {

                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115),

                corner(Dot, 999)

            local function createViewport(parent)
                local ViewportWrap = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = parent,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.50, 0, 0, 290),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -8),
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ClipsDescendants = false,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                })


                local Halo = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = ViewportWrap,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 170),
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                })
                Halo:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
                corner(Halo, 999)
                mk("UIGradient", {
                    Parent = Halo,
                    Rotation = 90,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                    }),
                })
                local Floor = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = ViewportWrap,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 16),
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -22),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 10,
                })
                corner(Floor, 999)

                local Viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
                Viewport.Name = "HomeAvatarViewport"
                Viewport.Parent = ViewportWrap
                Viewport.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                Viewport.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                Viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                Viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
                Viewport.ZIndex = 11
                Viewport.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                pcall(function() Viewport.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) end)
                pcall(function() Viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.3, -1, -0.2) end)

                local World = Instance.new("WorldModel")
                World.Parent = Viewport

                local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
                Camera.Parent = Viewport
                Viewport.CurrentCamera = Camera

                local function cleanModel(model)
                    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("Script") or obj:IsA("LocalScript") or obj:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end

                local function getSourceModel()
                    local source = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if source and source.Parent then
                        local ok, clone = pcall(function()
                            return source:Clone()
                        end)
                        if ok and clone then
                            return clone
                        end
                    end

                    local ok, model = pcall(function()
                        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId)
                    end)
                    if ok and model then
                        return model
                    end
                    return nil
                end

                -- ==================== ANIMACIÓN PROPIA (R6 y R15, por código) ====================
                -- Se mueven los Motor6D girando su C0 alrededor de la propia articulación, en el espacio del
                -- torso (X = derecha, Y = arriba, -Z = adelante): así la misma pose sirve para R6 y R15.
                local HomeAnim = {}
                -- articulación abstracta -> nombres reales (R15 primero, R6 después)
                HomeAnim.JOINTS = {
                    Root = { "Root", "RootJoint" },
                    Waist = { "Waist" },
                    Neck = { "Neck" },
                    RShoulder = { "RightShoulder", "Right Shoulder" },
                    LShoulder = { "LeftShoulder", "Left Shoulder" },
                    RElbow = { "RightElbow" },
                    LElbow = { "LeftElbow" },
                    RHip = { "RightHip", "Right Hip" },
                    LHip = { "LeftHip", "Left Hip" },
                    RKnee = { "RightKnee" },
                    LKnee = { "LeftKnee" },
                }
                function HomeAnim.Rig(model)
                    local rig = { joints = {}, count = 0, r15 = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil }
                    for key, names in pairs(HomeAnim.JOINTS) do
                        for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                            local m = model:FindFirstChild(n, true)
                            if m and m:IsA("Motor6D") then
                                rig.joints[key] = { motor = m, base = m.C0 }
                                rig.count += 1
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    -- R6 no tiene cintura: lo de la cintura va al RootJoint
                    if not rig.joints.Waist and rig.joints.Root then
                        rig.waistIsRoot = true
                    end
                    -- largo y grosor de la pierna (para sentarse justo en el piso)
                    local function sizeY(n) local p = model:FindFirstChild(n) return p and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Size.Y or 0 end
                    local function sizeX(n) local p = model:FindFirstChild(n) return p and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Size.X or 0 end
                    if rig.r15 then
                        rig.legLen = sizeY("RightUpperLeg") + sizeY("RightLowerLeg") + sizeY("RightFoot")
                        rig.legThick = math.max(sizeX("RightUpperLeg"), 0.6)
                    else
                        rig.legLen = sizeY("Right Leg")
                        rig.legThick = math.max(sizeX("Right Leg"), 0.6)
                    end
                    if rig.legLen <= 0 then rig.legLen = 2 end
                    return rig
                end
                -- pose = { Key = { rx, ry, rz [, dy] } en grados (dy: subir/bajar en studs, solo Root)
                local function rotC0(j, a)
                    local base = j.base
                    local p = base.Position
                    local rot = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(a[1] or 0), math.rad(a[2] or 0), math.rad(a[3] or 0))
                    local lift = Vector3.new(0, a[4] or 0, 0)
                    return CFrame.new(p + lift) * rot * CFrame.new(-p) * base
                end
                function HomeAnim.Apply(rig, pose)
                    local waist = pose.Waist
                    for key, j in pairs(rig.joints) do
                        local a = pose[key]
                        if key == "Root" and rig.waistIsRoot and waist then
                            a = { (a and a[1] or 0) + waist[1], (a and a[2] or 0) + waist[2], (a and a[3] or 0) + waist[3], a and a[4] or 0 }
                        end
                        if a then
                            j.motor.C0 = rotC0(j, a)
                        else
                            j.motor.C0 = j.base
                        end
                    end
                end
                function HomeAnim.Reset(rig)
                    for _, j in pairs(rig.joints) do
                        pcall(function() j.motor.C0 = j.base end)
                    end
                end
                -- suma pose b * peso sobre a
                local function addPose(a, b, w)
                    for key, v in pairs(b) do
                        local cur = a[key]
                        if not cur then
                            cur = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
                            a[key] = cur
                        end
                        cur[1] = (cur[1] or 0) + (v[1] or 0) * w
                        cur[2] = (cur[2] or 0) + (v[2] or 0) * w
                        cur[3] = (cur[3] or 0) + (v[3] or 0) * w
                        cur[4] = (cur[4] or 0) + (v[4] or 0) * w
                    end
                end
                local function ease(x) return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
                local sin = math.sin

                -- ---------- acciones del avatar del jugador (u = 0..1 dentro de la acción) ----------
                HomeAnim.Actions = {
                    -- saludar: brazo derecho arriba y la mano va y viene
                    wave = { dur = 2.6, pose = function(u, t)
                        local w = sin(t * 9) * 22
                        return { RShoulder = { 0, 0, 150 + w * 0.3 }, RElbow = { 0, 0, 25 + w }, Neck = { 0, -8, 4 }, Waist = { 0, -6, 2 }, LShoulder = { 0, 0, -6 } }
                    end },
                    -- mirar a los lados: cabeza y torso siguen una curva izquierda-derecha
                    look = { dur = 3.4, pose = function(u)
                        local side = sin(u * math.pi * 2) * 1
                        return { Neck = { -4, side * 48, 0 }, Waist = { 0, side * 14, 0 }, RShoulder = { 0, 0, 4 }, LShoulder = { 0, 0, -4 } }
                    end },
                    -- estirarse: brazos arriba, se inclina para atrás y vuelve
                    stretch = { dur = 2.8, pose = function(u)
                        local k = sin(u * math.pi)
                        return { RShoulder = { 0, 0, 165 * k }, LShoulder = { 0, 0, -165 * k }, RElbow = { 0, 0, -10 * k }, LElbow = { 0, 0, 10 * k }, Waist = { 10 * k, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 12 * k, 0, 0 }, Root = { 0, 0, 0, 0.12 * k } }
                    end },
                    -- pasito: rebote con la cadera de lado a lado y brazos al ritmo
                    dance = { dur = 3.4, pose = function(u, t)
                        local b = sin(t * 8)
                        local bounce = math.abs(sin(t * 8)) * 0.18
                        return {
                            Root = { 0, b * 10, b * 6, bounce - 0.1 },
                            Waist = { 0, -b * 8, -b * 5 },
                            Neck = { 0, b * 10, -b * 6 },
                            RShoulder = { 60 + b * 30, 0, 20 }, LShoulder = { 60 - b * 30, 0, -20 },
                            RElbow = { 70, 0, 0 }, LElbow = { 70, 0, 0 },
                            RHip = { b * 12, 0, 4 }, LHip = { -b * 12, 0, -4 },
                            RKnee = { -math.max(0, b) * 25, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -math.max(0, -b) * 25, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end },
                    -- manos en la cintura con un leve balanceo
                    hips = { dur = 2.8, pose = function(u, t)
                        local s = sin(t * 2.4) * 4
                        return { RShoulder = { -10, 0, 38 }, LShoulder = { -10, 0, -38 }, RElbow = { 0, 0, -95 }, LElbow = { 0, 0, 95 }, Waist = { 0, s, s * 0.5 }, Neck = { -4, -s * 2, 0 } }
                    end },
                }
                HomeAnim.Order = { "look", "wave", "stretch", "hips", "dance" }

                -- respiración y peso (siempre)
                function HomeAnim.Idle(t)
                    local br = sin(t * 2.1)
                    local sway = sin(t * 0.9)
                    return {
                        Root = { 0, 0, sway * 2.2, br * 0.035 },
                        Waist = { br * 1.6, 0, -sway * 1.4 },
                        Neck = { -br * 1.5, sin(t * 0.55) * 7, sway * 1.2 },
                        RShoulder = { br * 2, 0, 4 + br * 2 },
                        LShoulder = { br * 2, 0, -4 - br * 2 },
                        RElbow = { 0, 0, 6 }, LElbow = { 0, 0, -6 },
                        RHip = { 0, 0, sway * 1.5 }, LHip = { 0, 0, sway * 1.5 },
                    }
                end

                -- controlador del avatar del jugador
                function HomeAnim.Player(rig)
                    local ctl = { t = 0, action = nil, actionT = 0, nextAt = 3, idx = 0 }
                    function ctl.Trigger(name)
                        if HomeAnim.Actions[name] then
                            ctl.action, ctl.actionT = name, 0
                        end
                    end
                    function ctl.Step(dt)
                        ctl.t += dt
                        local pose = HomeAnim.Idle(ctl.t)
                        if not ctl.action and ctl.t >= ctl.nextAt then
                            ctl.idx = ctl.idx % #HomeAnim.Order + 1
                            ctl.Trigger(HomeAnim.Order[ctl.idx])
                        end
                        if ctl.action then
                            local a = HomeAnim.Actions[ctl.action]
                            ctl.actionT += dt
                            local u = math.clamp(ctl.actionT / a.dur, 0, 1)
                            -- entra y sale suave (0.35 s de cada lado)
                            local w = math.min(1, ctl.actionT / 0.35, (a.dur - ctl.actionT) / 0.35)
                            addPose(pose, a.pose(u, ctl.t), ease(math.clamp(w, 0, 1)))
                            if ctl.actionT >= a.dur then
                                ctl.action = nil
                                ctl.nextAt = ctl.t + 3.5 + math.random() * 2.5
                            end
                        end
                        HomeAnim.Apply(rig, pose)
                    end
                    return ctl
                end

                -- controlador del Owner: sentado en el piso mirando de un lado a otro. Se puede agarrar con el dedo:
                -- cuelga como muñeco de trapo, al soltarlo cae, aterriza, camina a su lugar y se vuelve a sentar.
                -- Todo es matemática (resortes + gravedad), sin el motor de física: no agrega lag.
                -- env (opcional): { model, shadow, home = CFrame, floorY, H, standY }
                local function lerpPose(a, b, u)
                    local out = {}
                    for key, va in pairs(a) do
                        local vb = b[key] or { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
                        out[key] = { (va[1] or 0) + ((vb[1] or 0) - (va[1] or 0)) * u, (va[2] or 0) + ((vb[2] or 0) - (va[2] or 0)) * u,
                            (va[3] or 0) + ((vb[3] or 0) - (va[3] or 0)) * u, (va[4] or 0) + ((vb[4] or 0) - (va[4] or 0)) * u }
                    end
                    for key, vb in pairs(b) do
                        if not a[key] then
                            out[key] = { (vb[1] or 0) * u, (vb[2] or 0) * u, (vb[3] or 0) * u, (vb[4] or 0) * u }
                        end
                    end
                    return out
                end
                -- resorte amortiguado: devuelve valor y velocidad nuevos
                local function spring(x, v, target, k, damp, dt)
                    local a = (target - x) * k - v * damp
                    v = v + a * dt
                    return x + v * dt, v
                end

                function HomeAnim.Owner(rig, env)
                    local drop = rig.legLen - rig.legThick * 0.5
                    local ctl = {
                        t = 0, look = 0, lookTarget = 0, lookNext = 1.5, torso = 0,
                        state = "sit", stateT = 0,
                        roll = 0, rollV = 0, pitch = 0, pitchV = 0,
                        holdVel = Vector3.new(), vel = Vector3.new(),
                    }
                    local function sitPose(t)
                        local br = sin(t * 1.8)
                        return {
                            Root = { 0, 0, 0, -drop + br * 0.02 },
                            Waist = { 6 + br * 1.2, ctl.torso, 0 },
                            Neck = { -3 + br * 1, ctl.look, sin(t * 0.7) * 2 },
                            -- brazos para atrás, apoyados en el piso
                            RShoulder = { -28, 0, 14 }, LShoulder = { -28, 0, -14 },
                            RElbow = { 0, 0, 0 }, LElbow = { 0, 0, 0 },
                            -- piernas adelante, una un poco más doblada
                            RHip = { 90, 0, 6 }, LHip = { 84, 0, -8 },
                            RKnee = { -12, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -28, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end
                    -- colgando: los miembros siguen al balanceo con retraso y tiemblan según la velocidad
                    local function heldPose(t, wob)
                        local r = ctl.roll
                        local f1, f2 = sin(t * 11) * wob, sin(t * 13 + 1.3) * wob
                        return {
                            Root = { ctl.pitch * 0.4, 0, 0, 0 },
                            Waist = { -ctl.pitch * 0.3, f1 * 6, r * 0.25 },
                            Neck = { -22 + f2 * 10, r * 0.5, -r * 0.7 + f1 * 8 },
                            RShoulder = { f1 * 35, 0, 18 - r * 0.9 + f2 * 22 }, LShoulder = { -f2 * 35, 0, -18 - r * 0.9 - f1 * 22 },
                            RElbow = { 0, 0, 18 + f2 * 20 }, LElbow = { 0, 0, -18 - f1 * 20 },
                            RHip = { f2 * 38, 0, 5 - r * 0.6 }, LHip = { -f1 * 38, 0, -5 - r * 0.6 },
                            RKnee = { -12 - math.abs(f1) * 35, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -12 - math.abs(f2) * 35, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end
                    -- cayendo: agita brazos y piernas
                    local function fallPose(t)
                        local a, b = sin(t * 17), sin(t * 15 + 1)
                        return {
                            Neck = { 14, 0, a * 6 },
                            Waist = { 6, 0, b * 4 },
                            RShoulder = { 0, 0, 135 + a * 25 }, LShoulder = { 0, 0, -135 + b * 25 },
                            RElbow = { 0, 0, 25 + b * 20 }, LElbow = { 0, 0, -25 - a * 20 },
                            RHip = { 25 + a * 30, 0, 8 }, LHip = { 25 - a * 30, 0, -8 },
                            RKnee = { -40 - b * 20, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -40 + b * 20, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end
                    -- aterrizaje: se agacha por el golpe y rebota
                    local function landPose(u)
                        local k = sin(math.min(u, 1) * math.pi) -- 0 -> 1 -> 0
                        return {
                            Root = { 12 * k, 0, 0, -0.45 * k },
                            Neck = { -14 * k, 0, 0 },
                            RShoulder = { 25 * k, 0, 40 * k }, LShoulder = { 25 * k, 0, -40 * k },
                            RHip = { 45 * k, 0, 4 }, LHip = { 45 * k, 0, -4 },
                            RKnee = { -70 * k, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -70 * k, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end
                    -- caminar de vuelta
                    local function walkPose(ph)
                        local s = sin(ph)
                        return {
                            Root = { 0, s * 5, 0, math.abs(sin(ph)) * 0.08 },
                            Waist = { 3, -s * 6, 0 },
                            Neck = { -2, s * 4, 0 },
                            RShoulder = { -s * 28, 0, 6 }, LShoulder = { s * 28, 0, -6 },
                            RElbow = { 15, 0, 0 }, LElbow = { 15, 0, 0 },
                            RHip = { s * 30, 0, 0 }, LHip = { -s * 30, 0, 0 },
                            RKnee = { -math.max(0, -s) * 45, 0, 0 }, LKnee = { -math.max(0, s) * 45, 0, 0 },
                        }
                    end

                    local function facing()
                        return env.home - env.home.Position
                    end
                    local function moveShadow(p, height)
                        if not env.shadow then return end
                        local ahead = ctl.state == "sit" and (env.home.LookVector * (env.H * 0.18)) or Vector3.new()
                        local s = math.clamp(1 - height / (env.H * 2.2), 0.35, 1)
                        env.shadow.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, env.H * 0.85 * s, env.H * 0.85 * s)
                        env.shadow.Transparency = 0.62 + (1 - s) * 0.25
                        env.shadow.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.X + ahead.X, env.floorY + 0.03, p.Z + ahead.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                    end
                    function ctl.SetHome(cf)
                        env.home = cf
                        if ctl.state == "sit" then
                            env.model:PivotTo(cf)
                            moveShadow(cf.Position, 0)
                        end
                    end
                    -- dónde está "el agarre" (pecho) respecto al centro del personaje
                    local function holdOffset() return env.H * 0.2 end
                    function ctl.Grab()
                        if not env then return end
                        local piv = env.model:GetPivot()
                        ctl.hold = piv.Position + Vector3.new(0, holdOffset(), 0)
                        ctl.holdTarget = ctl.hold
                        ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "held", 0
                    end
                    function ctl.MoveTo(p)
                        if ctl.state ~= "held" then return end
                        -- los pies no pueden quedar bajo el piso
                        ctl.holdTarget = Vector3.new(p.X, math.max(p.Y, env.standY + holdOffset() + env.H * 0.05), p.Z)
                    end
                    function ctl.Release()
                        if ctl.state ~= "held" then return end
                        local v = ctl.holdVel
                        -- conserva el envión (limitado) y cae
                        ctl.vel = Vector3.new(math.clamp(v.X, -18, 18), math.clamp(v.Y, -10, 14), 0)
                        ctl.pos = ctl.hold - Vector3.new(0, holdOffset(), 0)
                        ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "fall", 0
                    end
                    function ctl.IsBusy()
                        return ctl.state ~= "sit"
                    end

                    function ctl.Step(dt)
                        ctl.t += dt
                        ctl.stateT += dt
                        local t = ctl.t
                        -- mirar a los lados (solo sentado)
                        if ctl.t >= ctl.lookNext then
                            local r = math.random()
                            ctl.lookTarget = r < 0.25 and 0 or ((r < 0.62 and -1 or 1) * (32 + math.random() * 26))
                            ctl.lookNext = ctl.t + 1.8 + math.random() * 2.6
                        end
                        local k = math.min(1, dt * 2.6)
                        ctl.look += (ctl.lookTarget - ctl.look) * k
                        ctl.torso += (ctl.lookTarget * 0.22 - ctl.torso) * k

                        if not env or ctl.state == "sit" then
                            HomeAnim.Apply(rig, sitPose(t))
                            return
                        end
                        local face = facing()
                        if ctl.state == "held" then
                            local prev = ctl.hold
                            ctl.hold = prev:Lerp(ctl.holdTarget, math.min(1, dt * 16))
                            local hv = (ctl.hold - prev) / math.max(dt, 1 / 120)
                            ctl.holdVel = ctl.holdVel:Lerp(hv, 0.5)
                            -- balanceo tipo péndulo: se inclina al revés del movimiento y oscila al frenar
                            ctl.roll, ctl.rollV = spring(ctl.roll, ctl.rollV, math.clamp(hv.X * 5, -60, 60), 90, 7, dt)
                            ctl.pitch, ctl.pitchV = spring(ctl.pitch, ctl.pitchV, math.clamp(-hv.Y * 3, -35, 35), 80, 7, dt)
                            local wob = math.clamp(ctl.holdVel.Magnitude / 10, 0.18, 1)
                            HomeAnim.Apply(rig, heldPose(t, wob))
                            env.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctl.hold) * face * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(ctl.roll)) * CFrame.new(0, -holdOffset(), 0))
                            moveShadow(ctl.hold, ctl.hold.Y - holdOffset() - env.standY)
                        elseif ctl.state == "fall" then
                            local g = env.H * 14 -- gravedad proporcional al tamaño (se siente igual en R6 y R15)
                            ctl.vel = Vector3.new(ctl.vel.X * (1 - math.min(1, dt * 1.5)), ctl.vel.Y - g * dt, 0)
                            ctl.pos = ctl.pos + ctl.vel * dt
                            ctl.roll, ctl.rollV = spring(ctl.roll, ctl.rollV, 0, 40, 5, dt)
                            HomeAnim.Apply(rig, fallPose(t))
                            if ctl.pos.Y <= env.standY then
                                ctl.pos = Vector3.new(ctl.pos.X, env.standY, ctl.pos.Z)
                                ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "land", 0
                            end
                            env.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctl.pos) * face * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(ctl.roll)))
                            moveShadow(ctl.pos, ctl.pos.Y - env.standY)
                        elseif ctl.state == "land" then
                            ctl.roll, ctl.rollV = spring(ctl.roll, ctl.rollV, 0, 60, 8, dt)
                            HomeAnim.Apply(rig, landPose(ctl.stateT / 0.5))
                            env.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctl.pos) * face * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(ctl.roll)))
                            moveShadow(ctl.pos, 0)
                            if ctl.stateT >= 0.55 then
                                ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "walk", 0
                                ctl.walkPhase = 0
                                ctl.walkFace = face
                            end
                        elseif ctl.state == "walk" then
                            local home = env.home.Position
                            local to = Vector3.new(home.X - ctl.pos.X, 0, home.Z - ctl.pos.Z)
                            local dist = to.Magnitude
                            if dist < 0.15 then
                                ctl.pos = Vector3.new(home.X, env.standY, home.Z)
                                ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "sitdown", 0
                                ctl.fromFace = ctl.walkFace
                            else
                                local speed = env.H * 1.3
                                local stepLen = math.min(dist, speed * dt)
                                ctl.pos = ctl.pos + to.Unit * stepLen
                                -- gira de a poco hacia donde camina
                                local want = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(), to.Unit)
                                ctl.walkFace = ctl.walkFace:Lerp(want, math.min(1, dt * 8))
                                ctl.walkPhase += dt * 11
                                HomeAnim.Apply(rig, walkPose(ctl.walkPhase))
                                env.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctl.pos) * ctl.walkFace)
                                moveShadow(ctl.pos, 0)
                            end
                        elseif ctl.state == "sitdown" then
                            -- se da vuelta hacia la cámara y se sienta igual que antes
                            local u = math.clamp(ctl.stateT / 0.7, 0, 1)
                            local e = ease(u)
                            HomeAnim.Apply(rig, lerpPose({}, sitPose(t), e))
                            env.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ctl.pos) * ctl.fromFace:Lerp(face, e))
                            if u >= 1 then
                                ctl.state, ctl.stateT = "sit", 0
                                ctl.roll, ctl.rollV, ctl.pitch, ctl.pitchV = 0, 0, 0, 0
                                env.model:PivotTo(env.home)
                                moveShadow(env.home.Position, 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return ctl
                end

                local model = getSourceModel()
                if model then
                    model.Name = "HomeAvatarModel"
                    cleanModel(model)
                    model.Parent = World

                    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    if root and model.PrimaryPart == nil then
                        pcall(function() model.PrimaryPart = root end)
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
                    end)

                    local okBox, cf, size = pcall(function()
                        return model:GetBoundingBox()
                    end)
                    if okBox and cf and size then
                        local biggest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
                        local focus = cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.22, 0)
                        local camPos = focus + Vector3.new(0.25, -biggest * 0.05, biggest * 1.30)
                        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos, focus)
                    else
                        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0.25, 2.0, 5.0), Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0))
                    end

                    -- un solo RenderStepped para los dos personajes, solo con la pestaña Inicio a la vista (30 fps)
                    local animAcc = 0
                    local function startAnimLoop()
                        if HomeAnim.Loop then return end
                        HomeAnim.Loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                            if not Viewport.Parent then
                                HomeAnim.Loop:Disconnect()
                                return
                            end
                            if not TabPage.Visible or PerfOpt.Flags.NoHomeAvatar then return end
                            animAcc += dt
                            if animAcc < 1 / 30 then return end
                            local step = math.min(animAcc, 0.1)
                            animAcc = 0
                            if HomeAnim.PlayerCtl then pcall(HomeAnim.PlayerCtl.Step, step) end
                            if HomeAnim.OwnerCtl then pcall(HomeAnim.OwnerCtl.Step, step) end
                            if HomeAnim.OwnerAfterStep then pcall(HomeAnim.OwnerAfterStep) end
                        end)
                        track(HomeAnim.Loop)
                    end
                    HomeAnim.StartLoop = startAnimLoop

                    -- ---------- agarrar al owner con el dedo ----------
                    -- Proyección propia (la cámara de la vista no está en workspace): FOV vertical + proporción de la vista.
                    local function camInfo()
                        local abs = Viewport.AbsoluteSize
                        local aspect = (abs.X > 0 and abs.Y > 0) and (abs.X / abs.Y) or 0.7
                        local tanV = math.tan(math.rad((tonumber(Camera.FieldOfView) or 70) / 2))
                        return abs, aspect, tanV
                    end
                    function HomeAnim.SetupOwnerGrab(ctl, env)
                        -- zona invisible que sigue al owner (encima del área para girar al jugador)
                        local Grab = mk("TextButton", {
                            Parent = ViewportWrap,
                            Name = "OwnerGrab",
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            Text = "",
                            AutoButtonColor = false,
                            ZIndex = 13,
                        })
                        local function project(p)
                            local abs, aspect, tanV = camInfo()
                            local cp = Camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
                            local d = -cp.Z
                            if d <= 0.01 then return nil end
                            return Vector2.new((cp.X / (d * tanV * aspect) + 1) / 2 * abs.X, (1 - cp.Y / (d * tanV)) / 2 * abs.Y), d, abs, tanV
                        end
                        -- punto de la pantalla -> punto en el plano donde está el owner (z de su lugar)
                        local function unproject(screen)
                            local abs, aspect, tanV = camInfo()
                            if abs.X <= 0 or abs.Y <= 0 then return nil end
                            local rel = screen - Viewport.AbsolutePosition
                            local nx, ny = rel.X / abs.X * 2 - 1, 1 - rel.Y / abs.Y * 2
                            local dir = Camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(nx * tanV * aspect, ny * tanV, -1))
                            local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
                            if math.abs(dir.Z) < 1e-4 then return nil end
                            local tt = (env.home.Position.Z - camPos.Z) / dir.Z
                            if tt <= 0 then return nil end
                            return camPos + dir * tt
                        end
                        local function updateGrab()
                            local piv = env.model:GetPivot()
                            local sitting = ctl.state == "sit"
                            local center = piv.Position + Vector3.new(0, sitting and -env.H * 0.2 or 0, 0)
                            local sp, d, abs, tanV = project(center)
                            if not sp then return end
                            local hPx = env.H / (2 * d * tanV) * abs.Y
                            local w, h = hPx * 0.75, hPx * (sitting and 0.7 or 1)
                            Grab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                            Grab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X - w / 2, sp.Y - h / 2)
                        end
                        HomeAnim.OwnerAfterStep = updateGrab
                        updateGrab()
                        function HomeAnim.OwnerHit(pos)
                            local a, sz = Grab.AbsolutePosition, Grab.AbsoluteSize
                            return pos.X >= a.X and pos.X <= a.X + sz.X and pos.Y >= a.Y and pos.Y <= a.Y + sz.Y
                        end
                        local holdInput, prevScroll = nil, true
                        local function screenOf(input) return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) end
                        Grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                            if holdInput then return end
                            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
